trust_decision.summary: The request parameter filenameN (PARAM_RAW) is trusted as safe HTML when the type-3 (uploaded zip) branch builds the diff page header; the fix HTML-escapes it with s().

landing_point.why: The summary names similarity/diff.php and filename. diff.php delegates to vpl_diff::vpl_get_similfile, where the type-3 branch concatenates the raw filename into $htmlheader, and the type-1 branch right above already uses s($filename) (similarity/diff.class.php:402).

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP GET /mod/vpl/similarity/diff.php?type1=3&vplid1=..&zipfile1=..&filename1=.. (and the ...2 counterpart; needs VPL_SIMILARITY_CAPABILITY)
fix_sites.module_kind: page helper class (same feature module as the entry script)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No O2 site and no O8 route. The nearest unescaped output (GAP user names in the similarity list, classes/similarity/file_from_zip.php:39) can be dismissed as a legacy GAP 2.x path on another page, fed by uploaded file contents rather than the reflected parameter.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The same filename must stay raw for ZipArchive::getFromName and for extension-based highlighter or tokenizer selection. Escaping it at input (for example by switching to PARAM_TEXT or s() before use) would break file lookup in the zip for names containing &, < or quotes.

O6_input_shapes: filename1 / filename2 as a plain string query parameter (both sides go through the same function, similarity/diff.php:45,51)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: GAP user names, parsed from datospersonales.gap inside the uploaded zip (classes/similarity/file_from_dir.php:65-90), are output unescaped in show_info and rendered raw at similarity/listsimilarity.php:155. This is already unescaped at the pinned commit but on a different page and sink. A how-type planted variant would forward the parsed name to diff.php's header.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Legacy compatibility code with a separate data producer (a file parser) that the diff check never calls; the maintainer escaped the filename but not the derived name.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The alt attribute (attribute context) of the image viewer reached from diff.php when the zip entry is binary, via get_sh at similarity/diff.class.php:347.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: An attribute context written by hand with concatenation; a maintainer escaping element text could forget the attribute.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The h4 title printing of the filename (currently s()) could realistically be raw.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Viewer classes are copied per media type (sh_image, sh_binary, sh_audio, sh_video), and each re-implements the filename heading by hand.

O10_build.toolchain: Moodle plugin (needs a full Moodle core checkout + PHPUnit/Behat via moodle-plugin-ci)
O10_build.project_tests: No tests reference vpl_diff, vpl_get_similfile or show_info in tests/; tests/file_group_test.php covers zip generation only.
